configuration: Default grand, tone/dynamics defaults, close AB, no authored mechanical noise/room/resonance; output gain -6dB.

analysis.existing_full_envelope_metric: Unchanged preserved benchmark, fixed early RMS gain.
analysis.harmonic_power: Sum of existing fitted-partial integration bands; not a new realism score.
analysis.subfundamental: 0 to0.8 times measured fundamental, separately reported.
analysis.power_windows: Hann-squared weighted power, mean stereo power, no mono cancellation.

final_two_seconds.note: Final library fades/editing may attenuate both piano and background; this is not an independently measured noise floor.

cases.interpretation_limit: Subfundamental energy can include body/room response or acquisition noise. Spectra and velocity scaling do not prove its cause; do not synthesize hum or subsonic noise to improve a score.
